Location for all resources. Microsoft Discovery is currently supported in East US, Sweden Central, and UK South; deploy into a supported region. All resources for a deployment must share the same region.
Provision the virtual network and subnets. Set false to bring your own network.
Name of the virtual network (when deployNetwork = true).
Address space for the virtual network (when deployNetwork = true).

Provision the user-assigned managed identity. Set false to bring your own.
Name of the managed identity (when deployManagedIdentity = true). 3-128 characters: letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
Resource ID of an existing managed identity (when deployManagedIdentity = false). Must be a Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities resource ID.
Optional principal (object) ID override for an existing managed identity. Leave empty to read it automatically from existingManagedIdentityResourceId.
Provision the Azure storage account and container. Set false to bring your own.
Globally unique storage account name (when deployStorage = true).
Replication SKU for the storage account (when deployStorage = true).
Name of the blob container for Discovery outputs. Discovery expects a container named "discoveryoutputs". Must be 3-63 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
Resource ID of an existing storage account (when deployStorage = false). Must be in this resource group for role assignment.
Assign Storage Blob Data Contributor to the identity on the storage account. Set false if the storage account is in another resource group.
